verdict.rationale: The pack shows Okta has a RESTful API for CRUD on users/groups via SCIM (okta-docs-3) and references rate limits (okta-docs-14) and event hooks (okta-docs-4), implying a broader REST API surface, but there is no direct evidence of pagination, filtering, or app-assignment endpoints, and probes for OpenAPI/spec discovery all 404 (okta-probe-1/2/3). Missing for 10: explicit docs/examples for pagination and filtering on Users/Groups APIs, app assignment endpoints, and a discoverable API reference or OpenAPI spec confirming auth flows.
